original: 本当に……、それでいいんだな
traducao: Are you really... sure about this?

original: ええ。\n私は決めたのです。もう逃げない、と
traducao: Yes.\nI've decided. I will run away no longer.

original: ……そうか
traducao: ...I see.

original: アッシュ。\nあなたは十分、王にふさわしい資質を\n持っています
traducao: Asch.\nYou have the qualities required to\nbecome a fine king.

original: ですから、どうか……
traducao: So, please...

original: ……そーいう事かよ
traducao: ...So that's how it is.

original: ……盗み聞きとは恐れ入るな。\nお前の性根は、\nどこまで腐っていやがるんだ
traducao: ...Eavesdropping now? Unbelievable.\nJust how rotten to the core\nis your true nature?

original: 聞きたくて聞いたんじゃねえ！\nお前らが勝手に話してたのが\n悪いんだろ！？
traducao: I didn't want to hear it!\nYou were the ones having a private chat.\nThat's your fault!

original: 二人で隠れてコソコソと……。\n胸糞悪ぃ……！！
traducao: Sneaking around together...\nIt pisses me off...!!

original: ルーク、違いますのよ！\n私達は……
traducao: Luke, it isn't like that!\nWe were just...

original: 胸糞悪いのはどっちだ。\n責任転嫁も大概にしやがれ！
traducao: You're the one pissing me off.\nStop shifting the blame!

original: いつまでもそうして甘ったれて、\nナタリア一人に国の未来を背負わせて！！
traducao: Keep acting like a spoiled brat,\nmaking Natalia bear the country's future!

original: それで文句を言おうなんざ、\n虫が良過ぎるんだよ！
traducao: And then you have the nerve to complain?\nDon't make me laugh!
Wha...

original: 何だと！？
traducao: What was that!?

original: 二人共、喧嘩はおやめになって！
traducao: Please, both of you, stop fighting!

original: っるせえ！\nナタリアだって、本当は\n俺がいなくなればいいと思ってんだろ！？
traducao: Shut up!\nEven Natalia, you really think\nit'd be better if I were gone, right!?

original: そんなこと……！
traducao: That's not...!

original: もういい、ナタリア。\n馬鹿に構うな。\n時間の無駄だ
traducao: Enough, Natalia.\nDon't mind the idiot.\nIt's a waste of time.

original: っくそ……。\nみんな、俺を馬鹿にしやがって……。\n俺は……
traducao: Damn it...\nEveryone making a fool out of me...\nI am...

original: 俺が……！\n第一王位継承者なんだぞ！！
traducao: I am...!\nThe first in line to the throne!!

original: ルーク……
traducao: Luke...

original: クエスト「二人の王」が\nエントリーされました。\nアンジュから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "The Two Kings" has\nbeen entered.\nYou can accept it from Ange.

original: 師匠！\n何で俺が、こいつなんかと\n一緒に行かなくちゃなんねーんだ！
traducao: Master!\nWhy do I have to go along\nwith this guy?!

original: それはこっちの台詞だ
traducao: That's my line.
What!?

original: 二人とも、落ち着きなさい
traducao: Calm down, both of you.

original: 何の為にここへ来たのか\nよもや、忘れたわけではあるまい？
traducao: Why did you come here?\nSurely, you haven't forgotten?

original: いずれは国の行く末を担うお前達に\n世界を見、人と触れ、見聞を広げよと\n陛下がお心を砕いて下さったのだ
traducao: To you who will bear the nation's future,\nthe king has graciously allowed you to see\nthe world, meet people, and learn.

original: その事を、二人ともが\nもっとよく理解する必要がある様だな
traducao: It seems that both of you\nneed to understand that better.

original: そんなん、する必要なんかねーよ。\n……うぜーっつの
traducao: I don't need to do anything like that.\n...So annoying.

original: ふん……
traducao: Hmph...

original: とにかく、話は目的地へ着いてからだ
traducao: Anyway, we'll talk when we reach our goal.

original: ○○、すまないが\n二人をよろしく頼む
traducao: ○○, I'm sorry,\nbut please take care of them.

original: おい
traducao: Hey.

original: おい！　聞こえねーのかよ！
traducao: Hey! Can't you hear me?!

original: ……うるせえ！\nガタガタわめくな。\n少し静かにしていろ、馬鹿が
traducao: ...Shut up!\nStop your whining.\nKeep quiet for a bit, idiot.

original: お前が無視すっからだろ！？
traducao: It's because you're ignoring me!?

original: その耳障りな馬鹿声で、いたずらに魔物を\n刺激するなと言っているんだ。\nそんな事もわからないのか……！
traducao: I'm telling you not to needlessly provoke\nmonsters with that annoying idiot voice.\nCan't you even understand that...!?

original: 貴様、ヴァンから一体何を学んできた
traducao: What on earth did you learn from Van?

original: 何っ！？
traducao: What!?

original: ……ちっ。\nとにかく先へ進むぞ
traducao: ...Tch.\nAnyway, let's keep going.

original: いちいちお前に言われなくても、\nわかってるっつーの
traducao: I don't need you to tell me every time,\nI get it already.

original: おい、○○。\nお前も遅れんじゃねーぞ！
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nDon't fall behind either!

original: おい……、お前に聞きたい事がある
traducao: Hey... I have something to ask you.

original: お前は、ナタリアをどう思っているんだ
traducao: What do you think of Natalia?

original: どうって、どーいう意味だよ？
traducao: What do you mean by that?

original: 決まっているだろう。\n国を……
traducao: It's obvious.\nThe country...

original: はっ。\nんなの、いちいち聞かれなくても\nわかってるよ！
traducao: Hah.\nI know that without you\nasking me every single time!

original: 別に何とも思っちゃいねーよ！\n誰かさんと違ってな！
traducao: I don't feel anything in particular!\nUnlike a certain someone!

original: ……っ、この馬鹿が！！\nナタリアと婚約しているお前が\nゆくゆくは王位を継ぐんだぞ
traducao: ...Ugh, you idiot!!\nYou're engaged to Natalia,\nand you'll eventually inherit the throne.

original: あいつは国の将来を案じ、\n何か行動を起こせないかと模索している
traducao: She worries about the country's future,\nand looks for something she can do.

original: そんなあいつを見て、\nお前は何も考えないのかと\n聞いているんだ！
traducao: Looking at Natalia like that,\nI'm asking if you don't\nthink about anything at all!

original: 知らねーっつの！\nうぜぇんだよ、そういうの！
traducao: I don't know!\nThat kind of talk is just annoying!

original: 大体、好きで今の立場に\n生まれたわけじゃねえし、\nナタリアとの婚約も俺の意志じゃねえ
traducao: In the first place, I didn't choose\nto be born into this position,\nor my engagement to Natalia.

original: 何で俺がそんな事で、\nいちいち悩まなくちゃなんねーんだよ！
traducao: Why do I have to\nworry about every little thing?!

original: お前の言い分はよくわかった
traducao: I understand what you're saying.

original: ……お前が心底、屑だって事もな
traducao: ...And that you're complete scum, too.

original: 俺に……、どうしろってんだよ。\n第一王位継承者は俺だ……だけど
traducao: What... do you want me to do?\nI'm the first in line... But still,

original: 本当は……、お前の方が……
traducao: The truth is... you're more...

original: ああもう、くそっ
traducao: Agh, damn it!

original: おい、お前はどうしたいんだよ
traducao: Hey, what do you want to do?

original: 屑に聞かせる義理はない
traducao: I have no obligation to tell scum.

original: 何なんだよその態度はよ。\n人がフツーに接してやってんのに！
traducao: What's up with that attitude?\nEven though I'm acting normal with you!

original: 頼んだ覚えはない
traducao: I don't remember asking you to.

original: 第一、話以前にお前は\n王族としての自覚がなさ過ぎる
traducao: First of all, you have too little\nawareness of being a royal.

original: 少しは自分の立場というものを考えろ！
traducao: Think about your own position a little!

original: 立場とか、どっちが先に生まれたとか。\nそんなつまんねえ事実を聞いてるんじゃねえ。\n俺は、お前がどうしたいかを聞いてんだ
traducao: Positions, or who was born first.\nI'm not asking about boring facts.\nI'm asking what you want to do.

original: それとも何か？\nお前にとって大事なのは\n自分の肩書きだけなのかよ
traducao: Or what?\nIs your own title\nthe only important thing to you?

original: 何を言うかと思えば……。\n屑の言う事は、所詮屑だな
traducao: Wondering what you would say...\nWhat scum says is just scum after all.

original: お前が思ってる程、簡単じゃねえんだよ！\n人も、国も！！
traducao: It's not as simple as you think!\nNeither people, nor the country!!

original: はっ
traducao: Hah.

original: ……てめえはお堅く\n考え過ぎなんだっつーの！！
traducao: ...I'm telling you, you're\nthinking too stiffly about it!!

original: 何だよ。\n別に……、本気でやり合う\nつもりなんかねーよ
traducao: What is it?\nIt's not like... I was planning\nto fight seriously or anything.

original: ……とにかく、\n真相はヴァンから明かされる
traducao: ...Anyway,\nVan will reveal the truth.

original: 話はそれからだ
traducao: We'll talk after that.

original: けっ。\n……わーったよ
traducao: Tch.\n...I got it.

original: ……これが、お前達の力か
traducao: ...So this is your power.

original: フッ……、なるほどな
traducao: Hmph... I see.

original: ……はぁ、はぁ……。\nそれで……師匠……
traducao: ...Hah, hah...\nSo... Master...

original: ……約束だ、……話してもらうぞ
traducao: ...We promised... you will tell us.

original: 今回の旅の目的は、他でもない……。\n陛下たっての希望で、私達は今こうしている。\nそう……
traducao: The goal of this trip is nothing else...\nBy the king's wish, we are doing this.\nYes...

original: 二人のうち、どちらが王としてふさわしいか。\nそれを見極める為に
traducao: To determine which of you\nis fit to be king.

original: 待ってくれよ……。\nそれじゃ、俺は王になれないって事なのか？
traducao: Wait a minute...\nSo that means I can't be king?

original: そうは言っていない。\nただ資質を見せてもらっているまでの事。\n世襲で政は良くはならんのが通例だ
traducao: I never said that.\nI am merely observing your qualities.\nHereditary rule rarely improves a nation.

original: ……もとより、ルーク。\nお前も今の立場にあぐらをかいて\n王になろうだなどと……
traducao: ...From the start, Luke.\nYou rest on your current position\nand expect to become king...

original: よもや、思ってはいないだろう？
traducao: Surely, you don't think that?

original: そ、それは……
traducao: Th-That's...

original: つまり、よりふさわしい資質を\n持った者が、王になる資格を得る……
traducao: In other words, the one with more\nfitting qualities gets the right...

original: そういう事なんだな？
traducao: Is that how it is?

original: 端的に言えばそういう事だ。\nそして…
traducao: To put it simply, yes.\nAnd...

original: 今回剣を交えた事で、その答えも\n大方私には見えてきたと思っている
traducao: By crossing swords with you this time,\nI believe I have mostly seen the answer.

original: それじゃあ……！
traducao: Then...!

original: 二人とも、失格だ
traducao: Both of you, disqualified.

original: 身近な人間といがみ合う事しか\n出来ぬお前達が、他者と協調し\n国をより良くしていく事など出来るのか？
traducao: You only bicker with those close to you.\nCan you cooperate with others\nand make the country better?

original: 私には、そうは思えんな
traducao: I do not think so.

original: ……そんな……
traducao: ...That can't be...

original: ……そういう事だったのかよ……！\nクソッ……！
traducao: ...So that was it...!\nDamn it...!

original: 手を煩わせたな、○○。\nすまなかった
traducao: I troubled you, ○○.\nI am sorry.

original: 目的は果たした。\n船へ戻るぞ
traducao: The objective is fulfilled.\nWe return to the ship.

original: ……おい、ヴァン。\n俺はもう休むからな
traducao: ...Hey, Van.\nI'm going to rest now.

original: ああ……。\nそうするといい
traducao: Ah...\nYou should do that.

original: 師匠……
traducao: Master...

original: どうした、ルーク
traducao: What is it, Luke?

original: 師匠は……俺の事……。\n…………
traducao: Master, you... about me...\n...

original: いや……。\nやっぱり何でもない
traducao: No...\nNever mind.

original: やはり、どちらも心の迷いが\n顔に出ているな……
traducao: As expected, both of them show\nhesitation in their hearts on their faces.

original: 思った通り、二人ともまだ、幼い
traducao: As I thought, both are still childish.

original: 今回の一件が、二人にとって\n己と、ひいては互いと\n真に向き合う契機となればいいのだがな
traducao: I hope this event becomes an opportunity\nfor them to truly face themselves,\nand consequently, each other.

original: その時こそ、私の悲願も……
traducao: And when that time comes, my wish...

original: フッ……。\nあえて陛下の敷いたレールの上を\n歩く必要もあるまい、という事だ
traducao: Hmph...\nThere is no need to purposely walk\non the rails laid down by the king.

original: どちらか一人がではなく、\n二人が心を一つとして\n国を治めるのも一つの道
traducao: Not just one of them,\nbut for both to unite their hearts\nand rule the country is also a path.

original: 未来とは定められたものではない。\nなれば、未来へ至る道も\n一つではないという事だ
traducao: The future is not predetermined.\nTherefore, the path to the future\nis also not singular.

original: そう……。\n決して、一つなどではないのだよ……
traducao: Yes...\nIt is by no means just one...

original: ふっ……
traducao: Hmph...

original: ……それではな、○○。\nこの度の協力、感謝する
traducao: ...Well then, ○○.\nI appreciate your help this time.

original: ……来たか
traducao: ...You're here.

original: 師匠、教えてくれ！
traducao: Master, tell me!

original: ヴァン、答えろ！\n何のつもりでこんな真似をする
traducao: Van, answer me!\nWhat's the meaning of this charade?

original: こんな真似とは？
traducao: What charade?

original: とぼけるな。\n散々、人を試す様な事をしやがって……
traducao: Don't play dumb.\nYou've been testing us this whole time...

original: 民間のギルドに身を寄せるなどという\nふざけた提案を承諾したのもそうだ。\nそれが王位を継ぐ修行に何の関係がある？
traducao: Agreeing to that ridiculous proposal\nof joining a civilian guild is the same.\nWhat does that have to do with ruling?

original: 一体お前は、何を企んでいるんだ
traducao: What on earth are you planning, Van?

original: うるせーっつの！\n師匠と話してるのは俺なんだ。\nお前は引っ込んでろ！！
traducao: I told you to shut up!\nI'm the one talking to Master Van.\nYou just stay out of it!!

original: 黙れ屑！！
traducao: Shut up, scum!!

original: やれやれ……。\nどうやら話をする雰囲気ではないらしい
traducao: Good grief...\nIt seems the mood isn't right for talking.

original: それではこうしよう、私を倒した方が\n事の真相を聞く権利を得る、というのは？
traducao: Then how about this, whoever defeats me\nearns the right to hear the truth?

original: 自信が無いのか？
traducao: Do you lack confidence?

original: そんな事ありません！
traducao: That's not true!

original: 俺はこんな屑とは違う！
traducao: I'm not like this scum!

original: ふっ、いいだろう
traducao: Hmph, very well.

original: ならば、全員まとめて相手をしよう。\n全力でかかってきなさい
traducao: Then I will take you all on at once.\nCome at me with all your strength.

original: ちっ……舐めやがって
traducao: Tch... don't underestimate me.

original: その言葉……後悔させてやるぜ！！
traducao: Those words... I'll make you regret them!!

original: やっぱ、こうなんのかよ……。\nどうして俺の話を聞いてくれないんだ？
traducao: I knew it'd come to this...\nWhy won't you just listen to me?

original: 何でなんだよ、師匠……！
traducao: Why is this happening, Master Van...!?

original: 待っていたぞ
traducao: I've been waiting.

original: 師匠……、俺は……、\n今度こそ負けねえ！
traducao: Master... I...\nI won't lose this time!

original: 足を引っ張るなよ、屑！
traducao: Don't drag me down, scum!

original: 屑って言うんじゃねえ！
traducao: Don't call me scum!
